# Code of Conduct

This repo follows the community's
[uppförandekod](https://frilansaresverige.se/uppforandekod). The short
version, in English:

- **Be decent.** We are colleagues, not competitors. Hard critique of ideas
  is fine; attacks on people are not. Harassment and discrimination lead to
  exclusion.
- **No spam.** Share what you build, but neither the community nor this
  repo is a sales channel.
- **Speak up.** If you see something that breaks the code — in an issue, a
  PR or a commit — tell an administrator in the community Slack, or report
  it through the [contact page](https://frilansaresverige.se/kontakt).

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions that break the code, and block
repeat offenders.
